accounting.rationale: Description paragraph defines the intrinsic operation.
Argument shall-restrictions are program restrictions, not numbered constraints.
Result value mixes processor-dependent approximation latitude with bounded result requirements and is split into fine units.
Processor-dependent approximation latitude is separated from half-revolution range requirements.
Requirement that the result is expressed in half-revolutions and lies in the stated range.
Example paragraph is illustrative; approximate example values are not exact oracles.
